rationale: Dense colored grain covers the frame, reducing fine detail in the stage decorations, lettering, and floor. Dark stage areas lose additional information, and small details appear soft despite recognizable outlines.

Strong blur extends across foreground runners and distant scenery. Faces, shirt graphics, race numbers, vegetation, and building edges are smeared, leaving broad shapes and colors but little fine detail.
The central structure has broad, diffuse contours and blurred architectural bands. Surrounding leaves merge into soft patches, with no crisply resolved surface texture or foliage detail.
Extreme blur reduces the central dark form and surrounding greenery to broad, indistinct shapes. Fine architectural or leaf detail is not visibly resolved anywhere in the image.

Dense vertical magenta, purple, and dark stripes replace roughly the left third of the scene. The remaining kitchen objects show visible grain and softness, especially the unreadable foreground package text.
Most of the frame is nearly black. A dim diagonal transition along the left is visibly grainy, with no identifiable objects or useful fine detail in either the lighter area or deep shadows.

Leaf veins and flower outlines are sharp, with softer background ground cover. However, substantial areas of both pale flowers are washed out to nearly featureless white, losing petal texture; the unqualified exposure claim overstates the visible result.

Cracked plaster, exposed masonry, wire mesh, and wood grain are crisply resolved. Surface colors and bright areas retain useful texture, while the deepest parts of the window have less visible detail.
